features.name: packets
features.definition: All observed packets, including zero payload.

features.name: bytes
features.definition: Sum of declared L4 payload lengths; captured bytes may be shorter.

features.name: fwd_packets
features.definition: Packets on canonical endpoint side A, independent of initiator.

features.name: fwd_bytes
features.definition: Declared L4 payload bytes on side A.

features.name: rev_packets
features.definition: Packets on canonical endpoint side B.

features.name: rev_bytes
features.definition: Declared L4 payload bytes on side B.

features.name: fwd_byte_ratio
features.definition: fwd_bytes / bytes; zero when bytes is zero.

features.name: duration_us
features.definition: max(0, maximum timestamp - first arrival timestamp); first arrival is not the minimum.

features.name: byte_rate_bps
features.definition: 8 * bytes / (duration_us / 1000000); zero at zero duration.

features.name: packet_rate_pps
features.definition: packets / (duration_us / 1000000); zero at zero duration.

features.name: mean_payload_len
features.definition: bytes / packets as float; zero for empty input.

features.name: min_payload_len
features.definition: Minimum declared payload length, including zero; zero for empty input.

features.name: max_payload_len
features.definition: Maximum declared payload length; zero for empty input.

features.name: stddev_payload_len
features.definition: Population stddev over all declared lengths; zero below two packets.

features.name: mean_iat_us
features.definition: Integer floor of mean over all adjacent arrival deltas, including overwritten ring samples.

features.name: min_iat_us
features.definition: Minimum over all adjacent arrival deltas; zero without intervals.

features.name: max_iat_us
features.definition: Maximum over all adjacent arrival deltas; zero without intervals.

features.name: stddev_iat_us
features.definition: Population stddev over all adjacent arrival deltas; zero below two intervals.

features.name: direction_switches
features.definition: Count of changes in canonical side between adjacent arrivals.

features.name: small_packet_ratio
features.definition: Fraction of declared lengths <= small_packet_max_len (inclusive); zero for empty input.

features.name: payload_entropy_bits
features.definition: Shannon entropy of pooled captured payload bytes (not per-packet average); zero without captured bytes.
